subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers collect live Slack Socket Mode reaction envelope proof for this issue before allowing a code fix attempt?
rationale: Source inspection shows handler support and plausible drop boundaries, but the reported failure happens before any visible log and cannot be safely localized without live Slack/Bolt envelope or trace evidence.

options.title: Collect live envelope proof first
options.body: Use a maintainer-controlled or reporter-redacted multi-account Slack setup to capture reaction add/remove envelopes and trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery investigation, while preserving this issue as the reaction-specific evidence thread.

options.title: Attempt a speculative code fix
options.body: A repair PR could add diagnostics or alter filtering, but it risks guessing without knowing whether Slack/Bolt emits the reaction envelope.

recommendation.title: Collect live envelope proof first
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer-controlled or reporter-redacted multi-account Slack setup to capture reaction add/remove envelopes and trace logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal on the Slack monitor filters and reaction/system-event authorization path where the proof would be interpreted.
